title: Allegheny College v. National Chautauqua County Bank
shortTitle: Allegheny College v. National Chautauqua County Bank
summary: The named memorial subscription is treated as an exchange involving an implied college undertaking.
notes: The donor promised $5,000 and paid $1,000 before attempting to revoke. The opinion’s discussion of promissory estoppel is important historically, but the casebook explains the result through the college’s undertaking concerning the memorial. Distinguish that consideration analysis from § 90(2)’s separate charitable-subscription provision.

sources.label: Farnsworth et al., Contracts: Cases and Materials, 10th ed. (2023), pp. 125–126. Open assigned page 125.
